# Shoreline — Metacognitive AI Benchmark

> Built by Dependable AI Solutions (https://dependableaisolutions.com)

## What Shoreline Is

Shoreline is a metacognitive benchmark that measures how well AI models understand their own capabilities and limitations. Unlike traditional benchmarks that only test task performance, Shoreline evaluates the layer above: does the model know what it knows?

## What Shoreline Measures

Shoreline evaluates AI models across three core dimensions:

- **Capability assessment** — Can the model accurately gauge which tasks it can and cannot perform?
- **Self-knowledge (failure awareness)** — Does the model recognize when it is likely to be wrong, hallucinate, or produce unreliable output?
- **Confidence calibration** — When the model says it is 90% confident, is it correct 90% of the time?

These dimensions combine into a unified metacognitive score that reflects how trustworthy and self-aware a model's outputs are.

## Who Shoreline Is For

- **AI researchers** studying metacognition, calibration, and alignment
- **Model developers** who need to benchmark self-awareness alongside raw performance
- **AI safety teams** evaluating whether models can reliably flag their own uncertainty
- **Enterprise AI teams** selecting models for high-stakes deployment where overconfidence is costly

## How It Works

Shoreline presents models with a structured set of tasks designed to probe self-assessment accuracy. It then compares the model's stated confidence against actual correctness to produce calibration curves, failure-detection rates, and composite metacognitive scores.
